title: Dialer Modes Compared: Preview, Power, Progressive and Predictive | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Preview, Power, Progressive and Predictive all place outbound calls, but they differ in who presses Dial, whether an agent is held before the customer's phone rings, and what can go wrong. This video explains how each mode of a dialer profile works in the CrestApps Contact Center for Orchard Core, what each one shows in the profile form, and a path for choosing which to use.

In this video:
• Three questions to ask of every mode
• Preview: the agent reviews the record, then clicks Dial
• Power and Progressive: the system dials for a reserved agent
• Predictive: one call per reserved agent, or Over-dial
• Side by side: who dials, who is held, what can be abandoned
• Which mode to choose, and a path from Preview to Predictive
